story.title: Flipkart Pauses IPO Plans Indefinitely Amid Rising Market Volatility and Crowded Public Issue Pipeline
story.summary: Walmart-owned Flipkart has indefinitely paused its long-anticipated IPO discussions as rising market volatility and a congested public issue pipeline make the timing unfavourable. The company is instead redirecting investment into its quick commerce arm, Flipkart Minutes, as e-commerce growth shows signs of plateauing. The pause follows similar postponements by other major Indian tech firms and signals caution in the broader Indian startup IPO market.
